Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Body Appreciation Scale (BAS; Avalos et al., 2005) The BAS is a 13-item measure of positive body image, in which items are rated on a 5-point scale (1 = Never, 5= Always).

Assessment of BMI.evidence_source: The PFRS was used to measure actual–ideal weight discrepancy and consists of 10 greyscale photographic images of real women representing the full range of BMI categories. Only female participants were asked to complete the scale by rating the figure that most closely matched their own body and the figure that they would most like to possess (1 = Figure with the lowest BMI, 10 = Figure with the highest BMI). This describes a scale that *represents* BMI categories, but not the method of BMI assessment (self-reported or measured) for the participants.
